title: Settings
subtitle: Preferences for the app, your hardware and your data. Changes are saved automatically.

general.desc: Language, appearance and how KeyHalo starts.
general.languageHint: Used everywhere in the app, the tray menu and the HUD.
general.themeHint: System follows your Windows light/dark setting.
general.startWithWindowsHint: Launch KeyHalo minimised to the tray when you sign in, so lighting and keymaps are ready.
general.trayHint: Closing the window keeps KeyHalo running in the notification area. Quit from the tray icon.
general.updatesHint: Look for a new release on GitHub at start and every few hours, and download it in the background. Nothing else is sent.
general.versionHint: Compare with the latest release on GitHub.
general.noReleases: No releases have been published yet.
general.autoUpdateHint: Updates download on their own; you choose when to restart.

lighting.desc: Make lighting comfortable and status colours readable for everyone.
lighting.reduceFlashingHint: Limits flashes to under 3 per second and smooths strobe-like effects. Recommended if you are sensitive to flashing light.
lighting.colorVisionHint: Status colours (battery, CPU, notifications) switch to a palette you can tell apart.
lighting.hudHint: A small overlay that confirms DPI, profile, layer and mic changes over any app or game.
lighting.hudDurationHint: How long the overlay stays on screen.

input.desc: What KeyHalo listens to, and what it never keeps.
input.statsHint: Counts key presses, clicks and mouse distance for the Dashboard, live WPM/APM and the key heatmap.
input.privacy: Keystrokes are only counted — never stored as text, never sent anywhere. The per-key heatmap stores how many times each key was pressed, not what you typed or when.
input.clearHint: Delete today's counters, history, lifetime totals and battery history.
input.clearHintCount: Delete history, battery data and the lifetime total of {keys} key presses.
input.clearConfirm: This deletes every statistics file (today, history, lifetime totals and battery history). Profiles, keymaps and typing results are not affected. This can't be undone.
input.cheatsheetHint: While you hold Ctrl, Shift, Alt or Win, keys light up with what they do in the focused app.
input.remapHint: Run your keymap packs' remaps, layers and macros. Turning this off keeps legends and lighting.
input.pauseAppsHint: Remaps and macros pass through untouched while these programs are focused. Keep competitive games with anti-cheat here.

safety.desc: KeyHalo is designed to never leave your hardware in a bad state.
safety.safeModeHint: Read-only: KeyHalo detects devices and shows diagnostics but never writes lighting, DPI or settings to hardware. Use it when testing a new device definition.
safety.safeModeOn: Safe mode is on: no commands are sent to your devices. Lighting changes only appear in the app.
safety.noFirmwareText: It only sends the same lighting and settings commands as the vendor's software, and it saves your device's original state before the first change so you can restore it from Devices.
safety.conflictsHint: Other RGB software can fight over the same device and cause flicker. Scan for running programs that control lighting.
safety.noConflicts: No conflicting RGB software is running.

tip.close: Close it (and disable its startup entry) while KeyHalo controls the same devices, or let each app control different devices.
tip.bridge: KeyHalo can drive devices through OpenRGB's SDK server: enable the bridge below instead of running both on the same device.

safety.dynamicLightingTip: If your device supports it, turn off "Use Dynamic Lighting on my devices" or move KeyHalo to the top of "Background light control" in Settings → Personalisation → Dynamic Lighting.

openrgb.desc: Control devices that OpenRGB supports through its SDK server.
openrgb.enabledHint: Start OpenRGB with its SDK server enabled. KeyHalo connects to it and treats its devices like any other.

api.desc: A small HTTP + WebSocket server on 127.0.0.1 for scripts, stream tools, games and AI agents.
api.enabledHint: Lets other programs on this PC read KeyHalo's state and trigger actions. It never listens on your network.
api.tokenHint: Requests must send it as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" or ?token=.
api.noToken: No token: any program — or web page — on this PC can call the API.
api.warning: Set a token if you browse untrusted sites while KeyHalo runs: without one, any web page could post actions to localhost.

github.desc: Your GitHub account is used to publish to the gallery and share gists.
github.clientIdHint: Only for people building KeyHalo themselves: the client ID of a GitHub OAuth app with device flow enabled. Leave empty to use the built-in one.

data.desc: Back up, move or reset everything KeyHalo stores on this PC.
data.folderHint: Settings, profiles, keymaps, statistics and installed community items live here.
data.exportHint: Settings, your profiles, keymap packs and automation rules in a single JSON file. Your GitHub token is never included.
data.exported: Backup saved: {profiles} profiles, {keymaps} keymap packs, {rules} rules.
data.importHint: Merge a KeyHalo backup into this PC. Existing items are kept; imported rules start disabled.
data.notBackup: This file isn't a KeyHalo backup.
data.restoreNote: Settings are replaced; profiles, packs and rules are added next to yours. Imported rules start disabled.
data.resetHint: Put every setting back to its default. Your profiles, keymaps, rules, statistics and GitHub sign-in are kept.
data.resetConfirm: Every option on this page goes back to its default value. Profiles, keymap packs, rules, statistics, installed community items and your GitHub sign-in are not touched.

about.tagline: Open-source studio for keyboards and mice: lighting, DPI, keymaps, typing practice and a community gallery.
about.creditProtocols: protocol research and documentation that made Razer and multi-vendor support possible (no GPL code is used).
about.creditKanata: inspiration for layers, tap-hold and the remapping model.
about.creditStack: the stack KeyHalo is built on.
